name: Overprint
keywords: risograph print overprint zine pink blue halftone
idea: A two-drum risograph zine: medium blue and fluorescent pink on newsprint. Inks multiply where they overlap, and the drums drift out of register.
note: Live: pointer-driven misregistration, multiply blending, dot-screen mask, spinning badge, highlighter swipe, misregistered button.
borrowed: Risograph printing as used in zines and gig posters: spot-colour drums printed one at a time, halftone screens, paper tooth, colours that multiply where they overlap, and imperfect registration.
mood: Warm, crafted, indie, a little punk. Suits designers, studios, cultural events, editorial and newsletters.

motion: Title prints in two passes (clip-path), pink lands slightly later.
Pointer position offsets the pink layer: `translate(calc(6px + var(--mx) * 22px), …)`.
Canvas halftone of photos at 15° (blue) and 75° (pink) screen angles.
watchouts: Pink and medium blue are both too light for body text. Body goes in Federal Blue.
Grain overlay must be `pointer-events: none` and low opacity.
Two inks maximum per spread. A third ink becomes clip art.
